p_label <- function(p) {
  if (p < .001) return("***")
  if (p < .01)  return("**")
  if (p < .05)  return("*")
  return("ns")
}

col_pre  <- "#4A90D9"
col_post <- "#E8925A"

th <- theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",

  )

cat("Configuration complete\n")

## 1.3 Plot helper functions

```{r plot_helpers}
# Panels reported as a percentage (word recognition, associative recall)
make_bar_plot_pct <- function(pre_vals, post_vals, y_label, sig_label) {

  n  <- length(pre_vals)
  id <- seq_len(n)

  long_df <- data.frame(
    id      = rep(id, 2),
    Session = factor(rep(c("Pre", "Post"), each = n), levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
    Rate    = c(pre_vals, post_vals) * 100
  )

  summ_df <- long_df %>%
    group_by(Session) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_rate = mean(Rate, na.rm = TRUE),
      se        = sd(Rate,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Rate))),
      .groups   = "drop"
    )

  y_max  <- max(long_df$Rate, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_bar  <- y_max + 6
  y_tick <- y_bar - 2

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = summ_df,
             aes(x = Session, y = mean_rate, fill = Session),
             width = 0.55, colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre" = col_pre, "Post" = col_post)) +
    geom_line(data = long_df,
              aes(x = Session, y = Rate, group = id),
              colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = long_df,
               aes(x = Session, y = Rate, fill = Session),
               shape = 21, size = 2.0, stroke = 0.5,
               colour = "white", alpha = 0.9,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, seed = 42, height = 0)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = summ_df,
                  aes(x = Session, ymin = mean_rate - se, ymax = mean_rate + se),
                  width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, colour = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_bar,  yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_tick, yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_tick, yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_bar + 1.5, label = sig_label,
             size = 4.5, vjust = 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_bar + 10),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Session", y = y_label) +
    th
}

# Panel reported on the raw 0-3 fidelity scale
make_bar_plot_scale <- function(pre_vals, post_vals, y_label, sig_label) {

  n  <- length(pre_vals)
  id <- seq_len(n)

  long_df <- data.frame(
    id      = rep(id, 2),
    Session = factor(rep(c("Pre", "Post"), each = n), levels = c("Pre", "Post")),
    Score   = c(pre_vals, post_vals)
  )

  summ_df <- long_df %>%
    group_by(Session) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
      SE   = sd(Score,   na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Score))),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  y_max  <- max(long_df$Score, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_bar  <- y_max + 0.2
  y_tick <- y_bar - 0.08

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = summ_df,
             aes(x = Session, y = Mean, fill = Session),
             width = 0.55, colour = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre" = col_pre, "Post" = col_post)) +
    geom_line(data = long_df,
              aes(x = Session, y = Score, group = id),
              colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = long_df,
               aes(x = Session, y = Score, fill = Session),
               shape = 21, size = 2.0, stroke = 0.5,
               colour = "white", alpha = 0.9,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, seed = 42, height = 0)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = summ_df,
                  aes(x = Session, ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE),
                  width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7, colour = "black") +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_bar,  yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_tick, yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_tick, yend = y_bar,  linewidth = 0.6) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_bar + 0.05, label = sig_label,
             size = 4.5, vjust = 0) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_bar + 0.3),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    labs(x = "Session", y = y_label) +
    th
}

cat("Plot helpers defined\n")
```

## 1.4 Load raw data

```{r load_data}
pre_raw <- read_excel(PRE_FILE, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(words), trimws(words) != "") %>%
  mutate(
    word_acc  = as.integer(numify(word_selection_Accuracy)),
    img_acc   = as.integer(numify(Images_Selection_Accuracy)),
    scale     = as.integer(numify(`scale manual`)),
    Condition = as.factor(Condition),
    sub       = as.factor(participant_id)
  )

post_raw <- read_excel(POST_FILE, sheet = 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(words), trimws(words) != "") %>%
  mutate(
    word_acc  = as.integer(numify(word_selection_Accuracy)),
    img_acc   = as.integer(numify(Images_Selection_Accuracy)),
    scale     = as.integer(numify(`scale manual`)),
    Condition = as.factor(Condition),
    sub       = as.factor(participant_id)
  )

cat(sprintf("PRE  rows: %d | Participants: %d\n", nrow(pre_raw), n_distinct(pre_raw$sub)))
cat(sprintf("POST rows: %d | Participants: %d\n", nrow(post_raw), n_distinct(post_raw$sub)))
```

# 2. Word Recognition (Familiarity)

All 28 participants, all 120 old items collapsed across condition.

```{r word_recognition}
fam_pp <- inner_join(
  pre_raw %>%
    filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old") %>%
    mutate(word_acc_filled = ifelse(is.na(word_acc), 0L, word_acc)) %>%
    group_by(sub) %>%
    summarise(Pre = mean(word_acc_filled == 1), .groups = "drop"),
  post_raw %>%
    filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old") %>%
    mutate(word_acc_filled = ifelse(is.na(word_acc), 0L, word_acc)) %>%
    group_by(sub) %>%
    summarise(Post = mean(word_acc_filled == 1), .groups = "drop"),
  by = "sub"
)

t_fam <- t.test(fam_pp$Post, fam_pp$Pre, paired = TRUE)
d_fam <- (mean(fam_pp$Pre) - mean(fam_pp$Post)) / sd(fam_pp$Pre - fam_pp$Post)

cat("=== Word Recognition — Pre vs Post ===\n")
cat(sprintf("N = %d\n", nrow(fam_pp)))
cat(sprintf("Pre:  %.1f%% (SD = %.1f%%)\n", mean(fam_pp$Pre)*100,  sd(fam_pp$Pre)*100))
cat(sprintf("Post: %.1f%% (SD = %.1f%%)\n", mean(fam_pp$Post)*100, sd(fam_pp$Post)*100))
cat(sprintf("t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.4f, d = %.2f %s\n",
            t_fam$parameter, t_fam$statistic, t_fam$p.value, d_fam, p_label(t_fam$p.value)))
```

---

# 3. Associative Recall (Recollection)

All 28 participants.

```{r associative_recall}
rec_pp <- inner_join(
  pre_raw %>%
    filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old") %>%
    mutate(word_acc_filled = ifelse(is.na(word_acc), 0L, word_acc),
           img_acc_filled  = ifelse(is.na(img_acc),  0L, img_acc)) %>%
    group_by(sub) %>%
    summarise(Pre = mean(word_acc_filled == 1 & img_acc_filled == 1), .groups = "drop"),
  post_raw %>%
    filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old") %>%
    mutate(word_acc_filled = ifelse(is.na(word_acc), 0L, word_acc),
           img_acc_filled  = ifelse(is.na(img_acc),  0L, img_acc)) %>%
    group_by(sub) %>%
    summarise(Post = mean(word_acc_filled == 1 & img_acc_filled == 1), .groups = "drop"),
  by = "sub"
)

t_rec <- t.test(rec_pp$Post, rec_pp$Pre, paired = TRUE)
d_rec <- (mean(rec_pp$Pre) - mean(rec_pp$Post)) / sd(rec_pp$Pre - rec_pp$Post)

cat("=== Associative Recall — Pre vs Post ===\n")
cat(sprintf("N = %d\n", nrow(rec_pp)))
cat(sprintf("Pre:  %.1f%% (SD = %.1f%%)\n", mean(rec_pp$Pre)*100,  sd(rec_pp$Pre)*100))
cat(sprintf("Post: %.1f%% (SD = %.1f%%)\n", mean(rec_pp$Post)*100, sd(rec_pp$Post)*100))
cat(sprintf("t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.4f, d = %.2f %s\n",
            t_rec$parameter, t_rec$statistic, t_rec$p.value, d_rec, p_label(t_rec$p.value)))
```

---

# 4. Memory Fidelity

Raw 0–3 scale means; sub-29 excluded (no post scale data available — recording issue).

```{r memory_fidelity}
scale_pre <- pre_raw %>%
  filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old",
         sub != "sub-29",
         !is.na(scale)) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  summarise(Pre = mean(scale, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

scale_post <- post_raw %>%
  filter(Corr_resp_Old_New_ == "Old",
         sub != "sub-29",
         !is.na(scale)) %>%
  group_by(sub) %>%
  summarise(Post = mean(scale, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

fid_scale <- inner_join(scale_pre, scale_post, by = "sub")

t_fid <- t.test(fid_scale$Post, fid_scale$Pre, paired = TRUE)
diff  <- fid_scale$Post - fid_scale$Pre
d_fid <- mean(diff) / sd(diff)

cat("=== Memory Fidelity — Pre vs Post (raw 0-3 scale, sub-29 excluded) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("N = %d\n", nrow(fid_scale)))
cat(sprintf("Pre  mean: %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n", mean(fid_scale$Pre),  sd(fid_scale$Pre)))
cat(sprintf("Post mean: %.2f (SD = %.2f)\n", mean(fid_scale$Post), sd(fid_scale$Post)))
cat(sprintf("t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.4f, d = %.2f %s\n",
            t_fid$parameter, t_fid$statistic, t_fid$p.value, d_fid, p_label(t_fid$p.value)))
```

# 5. Combined Figure

```{r fig_combined, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.2}
p_fam <- make_bar_plot_pct(fam_pp$Pre, fam_pp$Post,
                           "Word Recognition Accuracy (%)",
                           p_label(t_fam$p.value))

p_rec <- make_bar_plot_pct(rec_pp$Pre, rec_pp$Post,
                           "Associative Recall Accuracy (%)",
                           p_label(t_rec$p.value))

p_fid <- make_bar_plot_scale(fid_scale$Pre, fid_scale$Post,
                             "Memory Fidelity\n(mean score, 0\u20133 scale)",
                             p_label(t_fid$p.value))

p_combined <- (p_fam | p_rec | p_fid) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("i", "ii", "iii"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))

print(p_combined)

ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "FigS1e_combined.png"),
       p_combined, width = 7.0, height = 3.2, dpi = 600)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "FigS1e_combined.pdf"),
       p_combined, width = 7.0, height = 3.2, device = cairo_pdf)
cat("Saved: FigS1e_combined\n")

ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "FigS1e_i_WordRecognition.png"),
       p_fam, width = 2.2, height = 2.5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "FigS1e_ii_AssociativeRecall.png"),
       p_rec, width = 2.2, height = 2.5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, "FigS1e_iii_MemoryFidelity_Scale.png"),
       p_fid, width = 2.2, height = 2.5, dpi = 600)
cat("Saved: Individual panels\n")
```
